maria (DevEx): Running into runtime errors when enabling runtime: 'edge' for Next middleware — our JS SDK throws 'require is not defined' and TS errors about global 'fetch'. repro: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repro-edge-sdk

alex (SDK): That's expected: default package main is CJS and we use node builtins. Edge needs ESM + web APIs only. We're working on an edge entrypoint.

maria (DevEx): Any quick workarounds I can tell users?

alex (SDK): Workaround: dynamic ESM import of the edge build path. Example:
```
const { createClient } = await import('redwood-inference/dist/edge/index.mjs')
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RI_KEY })
const res = await client.generate({ prompt: 'hi' })
```
Also make sure package.json has "type": "module" or use that explicit path.

zoe (TS): TS tip — in middleware you get web types. If your tsconfig includes "node" lib, TS may prefer Node types. Add to tsconfig.json:
```
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "lib": ["ES2021", "DOM"],
    "skipLibCheck": true
  }
}
```
This stops wrong fetch/Headers typing mismatches.

sanjay (Infra): Also watch crypto differences — Edge runtimes expose Web Crypto. Replace `crypto.randomBytes` with `crypto.getRandomValues` or `crypto.subtle` usage. Example:
```
const arr = new Uint8Array(16)
crypto.getRandomValues(arr)
```

alex (SDK): We're going to ship:
- ESM edge entrypoint published to `dist/edge/index.mjs`
- guard node-only imports behind platform checks
- add Edge-specific TS types and tests (Vercel + CF)
ETA: early next week.

maria (DevEx): repro is at https://github.com/redwood-inference/repro-edge-sdk, middleware at /middleware.ts with runtime: 'edge'. includes failing example and minimal Next config.

alex (SDK): I'll take that. Short-term suggestion for docs: add an "Edge migration" section and a sample Next 13 middleware example. Also we can add a remark about not using `require()` or `fs`.

deploy-bot: preview deployed: https://vercel.app/repro-edge-sdk/pr-4

zoe (TS): I'll open a small PR to docs with tsconfig snippet and the crypto note.

alex (SDK): Thanks — I'll link the SDK PR here when ready and ping when the npm edge release is published. @maria @zoe
